# pixi-silk

> Smooth vector graphics for PixiJS v8. pixi-silk draws shapes as exact signed distance fields, so every edge is anti-aliased per pixel. Edges stay smooth at any zoom, rotation and device pixel ratio, without MSAA, and each object is one draw call.

pixi-silk 0.1.0 is an MIT-licensed TypeScript library. It needs pixi.js ^8 (peer dependency) and WebGL2.
- `SilkGraphics` is a display object with a Graphics-like API. It draws rects and squircles (per-corner radii), circles, ellipses, arcs, sectors, lines, polylines (smoothed or tapered), Bezier paths (stroke only), chart areas, hearts, stars, polygons and rounded triangles.
- Paint: colours, gradients (linear, radial, conic, along the path), a gaussian `blur` for glows and soft shadows, dashes and dots. Gradients mix in OKLab and are dithered. Strokes align inside, center or outside.
- `createSilkApp` creates a Pixi Application whose canvas maps 1:1 to device pixels, even at fractional ratios. It follows DPR changes, uses no MSAA and renders filters at screen resolution.
- Also: transforms (save, restore, translate, rotate, scale), hit testing against the real shapes, and motion helpers (damp, Spring, ease).
- Limits: WebGL2 only, no WebGPU yet. Free-form paths are stroke-only. Joins are always round.

Site: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev
Repository: https://github.com/schmooky/pixi-silk
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pixi-silk

## Quick start

```bash
npm install pixi-silk pixi.js
```

```ts
import { createSilkApp, SilkGraphics, conic, vertical } from 'pixi-silk';

const { app } = await createSilkApp({ parent: document.getElementById('stage')!, background: 0x000000 });
const g = new SilkGraphics();

g.roundRect(10, 10, 340, 140, 22, 0.6).fill(0x1c1c1e);                        // squircle card
g.arcSweep(80, 80, 44, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 1.5)
    .stroke({ width: 12, cap: 'round', gradient: conic([0x30d158, 0xffd60a, 0xff453a]) });
g.area([120, 100, 170, 80, 220, 92, 270, 60, 320, 70], 130, { smooth: 'monotone' })
    .fill(vertical([[0, 0xff9f0a, 0.8], [1, 0xff9f0a, 0]]))
    .stroke({ width: 2, color: 0xff9f0a, cap: 'round' });
app.stage.addChild(g);
```

## Key terms

- Anti-aliasing: Techniques that remove the jagged "staircase" look of edges on a pixel grid. Each edge pixel gets a partial colour proportional to how much of it the shape covers.
- Analytic anti-aliasing: Anti-aliasing computed exactly per pixel from the shape's geometry, not from extra samples. pixi-silk derives coverage from the signed distance to the shape and the size of one device pixel.
- MSAA: A GPU technique that stores several coverage samples per pixel (typically 4) and averages them. In PixiJS, you enable it with antialias: true. By default it covers only the main canvas. Filters and render textures must opt in one by one.
- Signed distance field: A function that returns the distance from any point to the nearest edge of a shape: negative inside, positive outside. Rendering a shape from its SDF gives exact edges at any scale.
- Device pixel ratio: The number of physical screen pixels per CSS pixel: 1 on standard displays, 2 or 3 on retina or HiDPI screens. Many laptops and phones have fractional ratios such as 1.25 or 1.5.
- Squircle: A rounded rectangle whose corners are superellipse arcs, so curvature grows gradually from the straight edge instead of jumping. iOS app icons and cards use it.
- Gradient banding: Visible steps in a smooth gradient caused by 8-bit colour precision, most obvious in dark, wide gradients.

## Docs

The docs are grouped into areas. Each area overview tours its features with live demos. Every guide lists the full-screen experiments that go deeper on it.

### Learn

- [Learn overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/learn/): Install pixi-silk, pick the entry points you need and build a first widget and a first editor canvas.
- [Getting started](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/getting-started/): Install pixi-silk next to pixi.js v8, create an app with createSilkApp and draw a squircle card, a gradient gauge and an area chart with SilkGraphics. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/getting-started.md)
- [Migrating from Graphics](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/migrating-from-graphics/): SilkGraphics follows the PixiJS v8 Graphics API: shapes on a path, fill and stroke, transforms. See what carries over, what differs and what to add. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/migrating-from-graphics.md)
- [Choose an entry point](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/choose-an-entry-point/): pixi-silk ships one entry point per feature. See what the root import holds, what lives under ui, text, layout, glass, glow and webgpu, and when to import each. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/choose-an-entry-point.md)
- [Your first widget](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/first-widget/): Build a pill button with SilkGraphics: a soft glow from a blurred fill, springs for hover and press, and a SilkText label. Then compare it with SilkButton. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/first-widget.md)
- [Your first editor canvas](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/first-editor-canvas/): Build an editor canvas in PixiJS v8 with the pixi-silk editor kit: a camera that pans and zooms, a grid, a selection store, outlines and a transform gizmo. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/first-editor-canvas.md)

### Shapes & strokes

- [Shapes & strokes overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shapes-and-strokes/): Every shape SilkGraphics draws, how to stroke and dash it, and how to combine shapes.
- [Shapes](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shapes/): Rects and squircles with per-corner radii, circles, ellipses, polygons, stars, arcs, rings and sectors, plus the transform stack that rotates them. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shapes.md)
  - Experiment: [Primitives](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/01-primitives/): Every shape kind side by side: rects, squircles, circles, arcs, sectors, lines, areas, dashes, icons and blur.
  - Experiment: [Rounded rects & squircles](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/07-rounded-rects/): Per-corner radii and continuous-curvature corners. Drag the smoothing slider to move from a circular corner to a squircle.
  - Experiment: [Icons](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/11-icons/): Sixteen glyphs built from primitives with save and translateTransform, drawn at 16, 28 and 56 px.
- [Lines & paths](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/lines-and-paths/): Lines and polylines with monotone or Catmull-Rom smoothing, miter, bevel and round joins, Bezier and SVG paths that fill and stroke, and tapered strokes. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/lines-and-paths.md)
- [Strokes & dashes](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/strokes-and-dashes/): Paint styles for fill() and stroke(), inside or outside stroke alignment, hairlines that fade instead of breaking up, and dashes and dots with caps. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/strokes-and-dashes.md)
- [Shape operations](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shape-operations/): Union, subtract, intersect and exclude shapes and SVG paths in PixiJS with fill({ op }) and boolean(). Results take strokes, gradients, blur and hit tests. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shape-operations.md)

### Paint

- [Paint overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/paint/): What goes inside a shape: gradients, shadows and blur, inner shadows, glass and glow.
- [Gradients](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gradients/): Linear, radial, conic, mesh and along-the-path gradients in OKLab with smooth easing, and half-float ramps with dither that stop dark gradients banding. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gradients.md)
  - Experiment: [Banding](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/13-banding/): Dark, wide gradients with and without dither. Turn on the 8x reveal to see the contour lines the dither hides.
- [Shadows & effects](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shadows-and-effects/): Blur a fill or stroke into glows and soft shadows, grow it with spread, add Figma-style inner shadows, progressive blur and plus-lighter blends, without filters. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shadows-and-effects.md)
- [Glass and glow](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/glass-and-glow/): Frosted glass that blurs and bends what is behind it, and neon light that adds up to white, from the pixi-silk/glass and pixi-silk/glow entry points. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/glass-and-glow.md)

### Text

- [Text overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/typography/): Labels and readouts drawn from distance fields, and text the reader can click and type into.
- [Text](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/text/): SilkText draws labels and readouts from a runtime SDF glyph atlas, with outlines, glows, gradients and tabular numbers. It lives in pixi-silk/text. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/text.md)
- [Editing text](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editing-text/): TextEditor turns a SilkText into a text layer people click and type into: caret, selection, undo, clipboard, forms and input methods, on the canvas. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editing-text.md)

### Interface

- [Interface overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/ui/): Buttons, radial menus, responsive layout, hit testing and motion for canvas interfaces.
- [Radial menus and buttons](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/radial-menus-and-buttons/): RadialMenu is a marking menu with nested rings and per-device tuning. SilkButton animates in and out and ignores input while it moves or is busy. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/radial-menus-and-buttons.md)
- [Layout and smart containers](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/layout/): Place blocks on portrait and landscape screens with SmartContainer records and breakpoints, then lay out what is inside them with flexbox. pixi-silk/ui/layout. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/layout.md)
- [Interaction and motion](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/interaction-and-motion/): Pointer events test the painted shape, so rings are hollow and lines react only on their stroke. damp, Spring and ease move things the same at any refresh rate. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/interaction-and-motion.md)

### Editor kit

- [Editor kit overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editor-kit/): The pieces of a design tool canvas: camera, rulers, gizmos, selection, path editing, pickers and panels.
- [Canvas and rulers](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/canvas-and-rulers/): Pan and zoom a PixiJS scene with a camera, then add a grid, rulers, draggable guides, redlines, a marquee and equal-gap markers around it. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/canvas-and-rulers.md)
- [Gizmos and selection](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gizmos-and-selection/): Move, rotate and resize PixiJS objects with a gizmo, snap them to smart guides, track the selection and undo every drag with a history stack. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gizmos-and-selection.md)
- [Path editing](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/path-editing/): Edit bezier paths in PixiJS: drag anchors and handles, add and delete points, draw new paths with a pen tool, and undo every edit as one step. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/path-editing.md)
- [Colour pickers](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/color-pickers/): Hue rings, a colour wheel, an OKLCH plane, channel sliders, swatches, a radial swatch popup and an eyedropper for PixiJS, all editing one colour model. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/color-pickers.md)
- [Editor tools](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editor-tools/): Action buttons that orbit the selection, a brush cursor with live resize and pen pressure, a hold-to-show mode ring and a sliding segmented switch. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editor-tools.md)
- [Dials and timeline](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/dials-and-timeline/): A jog wheel with fine control and inertia, scrub fields you drag sideways, and a compact animation timeline with keys, a loop range and zoom for PixiJS. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/dials-and-timeline.md)
- [Panels](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/panels/): Dockable panels drawn in Pixi with no DOM: a virtualised layer tree, a schema-driven property inspector with undo, and a minimap of the camera view. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/panels.md)

- [Examples overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/examples/): Whole screens built with pixi-silk: five design sheets rebuilt 1:1, gallery scenes and charts.
- [Showcase](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/showcase/): Five design sheets rebuilt pixel for pixel, three dashboard scenes and four light scenes, all drawn with pixi-silk. Open any of them in Studio. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/showcase.md)
  - Experiment: [Health cards (sheet 1)](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/30-sheet-health/): Ten Health cards over the first reference sheet. Drag the compare slider to check them against it.
  - Experiment: [Complications (sheet 2)](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/31-sheet-complications/): Twenty watch complications from the second reference sheet, laid out at its exact pixels.
  - Experiment: [Fitness & home (sheet 3)](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/32-sheet-fitness/): Twenty more widgets: calendar week, hike map, sound levels, elevation, water, wind and a boarding pass.
  - Experiment: [Live Activities (sheet 4)](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/33-sheet-live-activities/): Black cards with continuous corners and measured soft shadows on a light sheet, cropped like the reference.
  - Experiment: [Watch widgets (sheet 5)](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/34-sheet-watch/): Cycling, 2FA, now playing, crosshair, garage, AirPods compass, barometer and moon phase widgets.
  - Experiment: [Widget viewer](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/35-widget-viewer/): Pick any of the 81 widgets to see it large next to its crop of the reference, or laid over it.
  - Experiment: [Pills & waveforms](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/17-pills-waves/): Heart-rate pills and a live pressure waveform that share one gradient.
  - Experiment: [Health cards](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/19-health-cards/): Ten Apple Health style cards with area, bar, candle and range charts.
  - Experiment: [Sleep](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/22-sleep/): Sleep stage blocks with transitions, a night strip and a marching dotted arc.
  - Experiment: [Timers](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/23-timers/): Espresso ticks with analytic motion blur, run cadence bars and their controls.
  - Experiment: [Journeys](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/24-journeys/): Flight progress, train stations, a delivery route, a ride pickup and a race track.
  - Experiment: [Sky](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/25-sky/): Sunset pills with a glowing sun and stars, a golden-hour curve and a daylight bar.
  - Experiment: [Dashboard](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/26-dashboard/): Thirty live widgets in a masonry layout. Scroll to see the frame-rate independent smoothing.
- [Charts](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/charts/): Build area and line charts with monotone smoothing that never overshoots, fading gradient fills, dashed guides, bars and dots in SilkGraphics. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/charts.md)
  - Experiment: [Area chart](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/15-area-chart/): A smoothed series with a gradient fill, dotted guides, a dashed forecast and a NOW marker. Values ease on update.
  - Experiment: [Bar charts](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/16-bar-charts/): Slim bars split into past and future, and chunky stepped bars that grow in.
  - Experiment: [Ranges & levels](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/18-ranges/): Progress bars with markers, range segments and signal bars, at several sizes and pixel ratios.
  - Experiment: [Gauges](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/20-gauges/): An ISS flyover, a car battery, a heading dial with ticks, a barometer, a UV week and a dimmer.
  - Experiment: [Sparklines](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/21-sparklines/): Strokes coloured by value, gradient markers and threshold stops. Move the pointer over a line for the crosshair.

### Reference

- [Reference overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/reference/): The API reference, renderers, resolution, performance and the glossary.
- [Renderers](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/renderers/): pixi-silk renders on WebGL2 by default and on WebGPU when you ask for it. How to pick one, set up your own Pixi app and turn on batching. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/renderers.md)
- [Resolution & DPR](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/resolution/): createSilkApp maps the canvas 1:1 to device pixels, even at fractional DPRs, follows DPR changes and renders filters at screen resolution. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/resolution.md)
  - Experiment: [Resolution & device pixels](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/05-resolution/): A Siemens star and a one-device-pixel grating. Switch between 1x, 1.5x, 2x and 3x and check the 1:1 pixel mapping.
  - Experiment: [Filters & render textures](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/06-render-texture/): Graphics and SilkGraphics behind a filter and in a render texture, side by side at the screen resolution.
- [Performance](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/performance/): What a SilkGraphics costs on the CPU and GPU, how batching joins objects into one draw, and how to keep static layers and large canvases cheap. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/performance.md)
- [Glossary](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/glossary/): Short definitions of anti-aliasing, MSAA, SSAA, FXAA, signed distance fields, coverage, device pixel ratio, squircles, OKLab, banding and dithering. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/glossary.md)

### Architecture

- [Architecture overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/architecture/): How the shader draws a pixel, how pixi-silk compares with other anti-aliasing and how layout computes.
- [How it works](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/how-it-works/): One instanced quad per primitive, an exact signed distance per pixel, coverage from screen-space derivatives and dithered OKLab gradient ramps. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/how-it-works.md)
- [Anti-aliasing compared](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/anti-aliasing-compared/): MSAA, resolution, curve smoothness, supersampling, FXAA, @pixi/graphics-smooth and analytic SDF anti-aliasing in PixiJS v8, compared, with fixes by symptom. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/anti-aliasing-compared.md)
  - Experiment: [Infinite zoom](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/03-zoom/): Five nested levels, each 3000 times smaller than the last. Zoom in to see curves and hairlines at every scale.
  - Experiment: [Sub-pixel motion](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/04-subpixel/): Shapes drifting at 2 px per second. Compare how tessellated edges step between pixels and distance fields glide.
- [Layout engine](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/layout-engine/): pixi-silk/layout is the flex engine under SmartContainer and FlexContainer: plain nodes, CSS flexbox styles, measure functions and incremental passes. (Markdown: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/layout-engine.md)

## API reference

- [Overview](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/): every export, generated from the source JSDoc.
- [ConicGradient](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/ConicGradient/): Class. An angular ramp around a centre. On arcs it follows the arc. Create it with conic.
- [Gradient](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/Gradient/): Class. Base class of all gradients. Stops are interpolated premultiplied (OKLab by default), baked into a shared half-float atlas and dithered when sampled, so...
- [GradientAtlas](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/GradientAtlas/): Class. All gradient ramps live in one RGBA16F texture (one ramp per row), shared by every SilkGraphics.
- [LinearGradient](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/LinearGradient/): Class. A straight ramp between two points. Create it with linear, vertical or horizontal.
- [MeshGradient](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/MeshGradient/): Class. A smooth colour surface through a grid of control colours, like a gradient mesh in Illustrator.
- [PathGradient](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/PathGradient/): Class. A ramp that follows a stroke from its first point (t = 0) to its last (t = 1). Create it with along.
- [RadialGradient](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/RadialGradient/): Class. A ramp from a centre outwards, optionally starting at an inner radius. Create it with radial.
- [SilkGeometry](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/SilkGeometry/): Class. Geometry behind every SilkGraphics: one unit quad plus an interleaved instance buffer (40 floats per primitive). You rarely need it directly.
- [SilkGraphics](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/SilkGraphics/): Class. A PixiJS display object with a Graphics-like API. Every primitive is a signed distance field evaluated per pixel, so edges are smooth at any scale,...
- [SilkPipe](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/SilkPipe/): Class. Render pipe that draws runs of consecutive SilkGraphics in one instanced draw call, under WebGL2 and WebGPU. enableSilkBatching installs it.
- [Spring](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/classes/Spring/): Class. Damped harmonic spring (semi-implicit Euler with fixed sub-steps). stiffness / damping follow the usual UI spring convention (e.g. 170 / 26).
- [along](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/along/): Function. Gradient that follows a stroke from its first point (t = 0) to its last (t = 1).
- [catmullRom](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/catmullRom/): Function. Centripetal Catmull-Rom spline through the points (no cusps or self-loops).
- [conic](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/conic/): Function. Conic (angular) gradient. On arcs and sectors it spans the arc by default, so a ring's ramp always runs from its start cap to its end cap.
- [createSilkApp](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/createSilkApp/): Function. Creates a Pixi application tuned for smooth vector output:. Function createSilkApp of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [damp](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/damp/): Function. Exponential approach: moves current towards target. lambda is about 1/seconds, higher is snappier.
- [dampAngle](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/dampAngle/): Function. Damped angle approach along the shortest path. Function dampAngle of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [enableSilkBatching](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/enableSilkBatching/): Function. Turns on batching across objects: runs of consecutive SilkGraphics with the same blend mode and settings render in one draw call.
- [horizontal](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/horizontal/): Function. Left-to-right linear gradient across the painted shape. Function horizontal of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [linear](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/linear/): Function. Linear gradient. from / to default to top and bottom of the shape's box (units: 'shape').
- [linearToOklab](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/linearToOklab/): Function. Converts linear-light sRGB to OKLab (Björn Ottosson's perceptual colour space), used to interpolate gradients evenly.
- [mesh](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/mesh/): Function. Gradient mesh: cols x rows control colours (row by row, top-left first) spread over the painted shape's box, blended into one smooth surface.
- [monotoneX](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/monotoneX/): Function. Monotone cubic interpolation in x (Steffen's method, same family as d3's monotoneX).
- [oklabToLinear](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/oklabToLinear/): Function. Converts OKLab back to linear-light sRGB. Out-of-gamut colours fall outside 0..1, so callers clamp.
- [parseColor](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/parseColor/): Function. Any Pixi ColorSource as straight sRGB [r, g, b, a] (0..1), with alpha multiplied in. Memoised.
- [radial](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/radial/): Function. Radial gradient from center (default the box centre) out to radius, optionally starting at innerRadius.
- [toFlat](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/toFlat/): Function. Normalises [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...] or [{x, y}, ...] into a flat number array.
- [vertical](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/functions/vertical/): Function. Top-to-bottom linear gradient across the painted shape. Function vertical of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [AreaOptions](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/AreaOptions/): Interface. Options of area(): monotone smoothing of the series and its sample spacing.
- [ConicGradientOptions](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/ConicGradientOptions/): Interface. Options of conic: stops plus centre, start angle and sweep. Interface ConicGradientOptions of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [FillStyle](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/FillStyle/): Interface. How a fill is painted: colour or gradient, opacity, blur with spread, blend mode and inner shadows.
- [GradientOptions](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/GradientOptions/): Interface. Options shared by every gradient: colour stops, interpolation space, easing, extend mode and units.
- [InnerShadow](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/InnerShadow/): Interface. A shadow drawn inside the shape from its own distance field, with Figma's semantics. The shape is moved by x and y, shrunk by spread and blurred.
- [LinearGradientOptions](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/LinearGradientOptions/): Interface. Options of linear: stops plus the start and end points of the ramp. Interface LinearGradientOptions of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [MeshGradientOptions](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/MeshGradientOptions/): Interface. Options of mesh: where the grid sits, its units and its interpolation space.
- [PolylineOptions](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/PolylineOptions/): Interface. Options of polyline(): closed loops and monotone or Catmull-Rom smoothing of the points.
- [ProgressiveBlur](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/ProgressiveBlur/): Interface. A blur that changes across the shape, like Figma's progressive layer blur.
- [RadialGradientOptions](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/RadialGradientOptions/): Interface. Options of radial: stops plus centre, outer radius and inner radius. Interface RadialGradientOptions of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [SilkApp](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/SilkApp/): Interface. What createSilkApp returns: the Pixi application, its CSS size and resolution, and helpers to change or destroy it.
- [SilkAppOptions](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/SilkAppOptions/): Interface. Options of createSilkApp: Pixi application options plus the element to fill, DPR limits and touch behaviour.
- [SilkGraphicsOptions](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/SilkGraphicsOptions/): Interface. Per-object rendering settings of a SilkGraphics: dithering, anti-aliasing width and hairline threshold.
- [StrokeStyle](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/interfaces/StrokeStyle/): Interface. How a stroke is painted: width (or tapered widths), alignment, caps, dashes, plus everything in FillStyle.
- [ColorSpace](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/ColorSpace/): Type. Colour space gradients are interpolated in: perceptual OKLab (default), linear light, or plain sRGB.
- [Easing](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/Easing/): Type. How the ramp moves between stops. Type Easing of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [ExtendMode](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/ExtendMode/): Type. What a gradient does outside 0..1: hold the end colours (pad), tile (repeat) or mirror (reflect).
- [FillInput](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/FillInput/): Type. What fill() accepts: any Pixi colour, a gradient or a FillStyle. Type FillInput of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [GradientUnits](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/GradientUnits/): Type. Gradient coordinates: shape = fractions of each painted shape's box, local = the graphics' local units (one ramp across many shapes).
- [LineCap](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/LineCap/): Type. Shape of the ends of open paths and of every dash: flat, round or square.
- [LineJoin](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/LineJoin/): Type. Shape of the corners where two segments of a stroke meet. Type LineJoin of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [MeshColorInput](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/MeshColorInput/): Type. A mesh control colour: any Pixi colour, or [color, alpha]. Type MeshColorInput of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [PointsInput](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/PointsInput/): Type. Points as a flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...] array, a typed array, or an array of { x, y } objects.
- [RGBA](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/RGBA/): Type. Straight (non-premultiplied) sRGB colour with alpha, all channels 0..1, as returned by parseColor.
- [ShapeOp](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/ShapeOp/): Type. A shape operation: union merges, subtract cuts the later shapes out of the first, intersect keeps the overlap, and exclude keeps what is covered an odd...
- [StopInput](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/StopInput/): Type. A color stop: a bare color (stops are spread evenly), [offset, color], [offset, color, alpha] or { offset, color, alpha }.
- [StrokeInput](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/StrokeInput/): Type. What stroke() accepts: any Pixi colour, a gradient or a StrokeStyle. Type StrokeInput of pixi-silk, smooth anti-aliased graphics for PixiJS v8.
- [Vec2](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/types/Vec2/): Type. A point [x, y]. In shape units, x and y are fractions of the painted shape's box.
- [ease](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/api/variables/ease/): Variable. Easing curves for tweens (t from 0 to 1): inOutCubic, outCubic, inOutSine, outExpo.
